purpose: Qualify the code-benchmark harness glue before its numbers gate any promotion.

fixture.shape: HumanEval-like: the PROMPT provides a helper (is_even) that the completion reuses
fixture.prompt: def is_even(n): return n%2==0 ;; def count_evens(xs): <docstring>
fixture.completion_concise: def count_evens(xs): return sum(1 for x in xs if is_even(x))
fixture.note: The concise completion relies on the prompt-provided helper — exactly the pattern that produced the 0/60 incident when the prompt was not prepended.
